Overview

Tiruchirappalli is a city in Tamil Nadu with a population of 1,000,000. A historic city in Tamil Nadu, known for the Rockfort Temple, Srirangam temple complex, and its central location in the state. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
